title: How to Create a Microsoft Account in Windows 11? - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Welcome, everyone! Today I will assist in demonstrating proving procedures of creating a new MS account or linking an existing one to Windows 11. Most of the time, Windows 11 OS can be run without creating this or that account, yet it is impossible to appreciate all the features of the new OS to the fullest extent without having a Microsoft account. It directly helps in the administration of the services which are offered by Microsoft including OneDrive, Microsoft Store, Office Online, Xbox Live, and many others. Microsoft account makes the environment familiar regardless of the device that is being used since it enables the synchronizing of settings and files via the internet.

This tutorial will help if you are activating a new device or just adding an account to an existing device. From setting up the environment that you will be working on to confirming your account to enable you to optimize your use of Microsoft with your newly installed Windows 11. By following the steps above, you will be able to use all the amenities that go with having a Microsoft account. Let's get started!

Prerequisites

In order to start recording you will need the following:

  • An active internet connection.
  • An email address (for the creation of a new Microsoft account).
  • Basic personal information (nationality, date of birth, etc.).
  • Windows 11 installed on your computer.

Step-by-Step Guide to Creating a Microsoft Account:-

Step 1: Open the Settings app.

Step 2: To access all the options related to accounts, go to the Settings panel and select Accounts in the list on the left.

Step 3: After scrolling down the options, look for and click on Emails & accounts.

Step 4: Navigate to the section that says Add a Microsoft account and click on it.

Step 5: After this, a pop-up will appear informing you to sign into your current Microsoft account. In case you have an account in Microsoft, just log in.

Step 6: If you have no Microsoft account, click on the words Create one! You will see it after the word ‘No account?’ in blue.

Step 7: You are supposed to associate this Microsoft account with your email of your desire. If you already have an email type it in and create a password.

Step 8: Choose the proper password for your account.

Step 9: You will for instance be asked to provide some of your particulars such as the country you are from, date of birth, among others. Once you have filled them in, select Next.

Step 10: The one-time password (OTP) will be sent to the email address used when creating the previous account they intend to use. Take the code that was received and paste it into the corresponding box and click on the Next button.

Step 11: This is necessary to prove that you are not a robot, once you complete this step, click on the Next button.

Conclusion

Congratulations! You have created your new Microsoft account or have added the account in your Windows 11 successfully. By doing this, you have opened yourself to countless opportunities and ease that accompanies having a Microsoft account. With your new account, you are able to use other Microsoft products and programs which include One Drive for storage, outlook for mail and Microsoft store for apps and games. Also, by having a ‘Microsoft account’, settings and preferences can be customized for, on every Windows device the user comes across.
